answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds tied to a public trellis of verified actions. Each agent must lock collateral and build reputation over epochs; a whisper of collusion triggers peer review, and honest nodes raise the attacker's cost by slashing stakes. Fake accounts cannot ride the reputation tide without sustained, costly participation, so mass identity creation becomes economically unviable. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
